senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (b. h.) Goliath, the Philistine.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 8:1">Sot. VIII, 1</cite> <he>בנצחונו של ג׳</he> relying on the strength of G.
<cite ref="Sotah 42b:8">Ib. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>ג̇ל̇י̇ת … בג̇יל̇וי̇ פנים וכ׳</he> he is named G., because he stood before the Lord with barefacedness (defiance).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>; a. fr.
